hooks.command: echo 'Follow the global instructions. Classify the request, apply its gate: code/debug=Superpowers, even small edits. Plots=Superpowers+scientific-plot-maker. Research=no Superpowers. Papers=scribe. README=readmaker. Docs=docs/ folder. Only if asked: ingest=ingest-context, handoff=session-handoff.'

statusLine.command: sh -c 'for p in python3 python py; do command -v "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 && "$p" -c "import sys;sys.exit(sys.version_info<(3,))" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$p" "${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/statusline.py"; done; echo "statusline: python3 not found"'
